first.rationale: Prioritize the controllable decline in onboarding completion and activation with an intervention that has previously improved both time-to-value and first-week activation. This supports sustainable qualified revenue more directly than promotional pricing, whose prior retention cost makes it unsuitable as the primary response despite competitive pressure. Verify the two onboarding records before committing to confirm segment fit and implementation details.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment to shorten the onboarding flow, targeting the observed completion and activation declines. The verified onboarding experiment improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. SMB signup simplification also improved qualified revenue, though its 1% retention decline requires guardrails. Measure qualified revenue and 30-day retention by segment, especially SMB, and do not use broad promotional pricing given its known material retention harm.
